text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 28th October 2008 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2008 HERITAGE ORCHIDS OF SINGAPORE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 28TH OCTOBER 2008
Denomination
Metal
Standard Weight
Standard Diameter
Standard Thickness
Shape
Edge
Design of Obverse
Design of Reverse
5 Dollars
999 Fine Silver
20.00 g + 0.20 g
38.70 mm + 0.15 mm
2.50 mm + 0.30 mm
Round
Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2008” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The coin design features the orchid “Oncidium Goldiana” in full colour in the lower-right to upper-left of the coin and the name of the orchid is along the upper circumference. The weight in grams and fineness of the coin are at the lower circumference. The denomination is at the left of the coin.
5 Dollars
999 Fine Silver
20.00 g + 0.20 g
38.70 mm + 0.15 mm
2.50 mm + 0.30 mm
Round
The coin design features the orchid “Aranda Tay Swee Eng” in full colour in the lower centre of the coin and the name of the orchid is along the upper circumference. The weight in grams and fineness of the coin are at the lower circumference. The denomination is at the right of the coin.
(a) Reverse Design of the $5 Silver Proof Coin (Oncidium Goldiana).
(b) Reverse Design of the $5 Silver Proof Coin (Aranda Tay Swee Eng).
(c) Common Obverse Design for $5 Silver Proof Coins (Oncidium Goldiana and Aranda Tay Swee Eng).
